name: Drawing Nigh To God
overview: Scripture calls believers to approach God with sincere hearts and unwavering faith, as seen in Hebrews 10:22, which emphasizes drawing near with a true heart and a cleansed conscience. James 4 further instructs us to submit to God, resist the devil, and purify our hearts, promising that as we draw near to God, He will draw near to us. Humility before the Lord is essential, for He promises to exalt those who humble themselves in His sight.
